nodes.label: Expo Design System (Cool-White Monochromatic)
nodes.rationale: Design system extraction for Expo website. Key characteristics: cool-white canvas (#f0f0f3), strictly monochromatic with pure black headlines, pill-shaped geometry everywhere (24px-9999px radius), massive 64px display with extreme negative tracking (-1.6px to -3px), Inter as sole typeface, whisper-soft shadows.
